summary: Iteration 4 tested chat threads, the free-contact limit, profile visits, admin Prices, Growth charts and the User journey, on both backend and frontend. BACKEND: the new tests/test_iter4_chat_pricing_growth.py has 7 grouped tests and all pass. What passed: POST /chats (401 without a token, 400 without a business profile, the same thread comes back on repeat, status 'chat', free_chat true, chat_open true); messages from both parties work in a free thread and an admin gets 403; deal actions on a chat thread return 400; an offer converts the same thread into 'pending' with the same id and keeps the chat history; contacts_used and free_contacts in /me; a 4th new creator gets 402 on both /chats and /deals; existing contacts are still allowed; Pro is unlimited (free_chat false); a thread created while Pro closes after Pro lapses while free threads stay open; profile visits count once per viewer per day, own views aren't counted, and the view endpoint gives 401 without a token; GET /admin/pricing returns 401, 403 or 200; PUT is 403 for a helper; all 8 range-boundary checks return 422; owner PUT 200, /config shows the new values, a Pro order uses the new price, and the 'changed prices' log entry is written; growth with days 30, 90 and 365 returns the right series length and keys, and 3 or 400 return 422; /track returns 422 for a short session_id or an empty page; journey for all 4 ranges returns sessions, funnel, accounts and pages with the right keys. Regression: test_hiremyface_api.py had 3 failures caused by the intended rule change (free_offer_limit was replaced by free contacts, and free chats are now open). I updated those tests and it is now 26/26. test_iter2_features is 21/21 and test_admin_panel is 19/19. FRONTEND (Playwright, Clerk tickets): Message on a creator profile goes to /app/chat/{id} with 'Chat · no offer yet' and a composer that works for a free business; repeat Message opens the same thread; the Deals page hides chat threads and the Chat list shows them; the creator sees chat-no-offer-note and no Send offer button, and can reply; Send offer from the thread opens OfferDialog and the same thread becomes Pending with a summary and both messages kept. Visits shows for the business and on your own profile; the Profile page shows Visits. At 390px the 4-stat row fits. On the 4th new creator, Message shows the 402 toast and redirects to /app/upgrade, while an existing contact still opens chat. Admin dashboard: growth charts render and the 30d/90d/1y switch triggers fetches; the journey funnels and 'Where people stop' table render, and the range switch works. Helper on Prices: read-only, no Save button. Owner on Prices: the invalid fee_pct 60 shows a toast; saving 1299/45/12/5 shows 'Prices updated', the Upgrade page shows ₹1,299 / 45 days with 5 contacts and a 12% fee, and Activity shows 'changed prices'. Track calls fire on route changes, including Creator setup steps (checked in code). All admin pages load at 1920px and 390px with no horizontal overflow. Prices were restored to defaults (settings doc deleted) and the admin role restored.

minor.issue: It doesn't check that the creator exists. Any id creates a profile_views doc (confirmed with TEST_nonexistent_creator returning 200 and creating 1 doc). Add a find_one check first, or skip the upsert.

Public with no rate limit or page whitelist, so anyone can flood the events collection or inject fake page names into the admin journey. Consider whitelisting page names (or a regex) and adding a simple per-IP or per-session rate limit.

The steps are independent 'did the session ever hit X' checks, not sequential. Later steps can be larger than earlier ones (seen: 'Entered the app' 6 after 'Opened sign in' 5, and 'Opened a chat' 4 after 'Started a profile setup' 0), because signed-in users skip Sign in and businesses don't run setup. Make it a true sequential funnel, or present the steps as independent reach metrics.
Returns chat threads (status 'chat', price 0, plan_label 'Chat') mixed in with real deals. Filter status != 'chat', or label them in AdminDeals.
Not atomic. Two parallel POST /chats calls to different new creators at contacts_used = limit-1 can both pass (read then insert). Low impact.

ui_bugs.issue: Shows '−-20%' (double minus) when a step is larger than the previous one. lost goes negative and is rendered with a hard-coded '−' prefix. A step after a 0 step shows no percentage.
The upgrade button is hard-coded as 'Upgrade · ₹999/mo' and ignores config.pro_price and pro_days.
The 'Platform earnings' sub-label is hard-coded as '10% fee + Pro subscriptions'. It still said 10% after fee_pct was changed to 12.
Copy is hard-coded: the 'Extend 30 days' button, the '10% service fee' text in Settings, and 'Message 3 creators free' on Landing. Use config.pro_days, fee_pct and free_contacts.

Each route change sends /track twice, and /creators/{id}/view twice, in preview because React.StrictMode double-runs effects. This doubles 'Views' and drags avg_seconds toward 0 in the journey table (preview only, prod is fine). Dedupe consecutive identical pages in track(), with a ref or a last-page check in sessionStorage.

ui_bugs.component: OfferDialog when 0 free contacts are left
ui_bugs.issue: For a new creator it still shows the full form ('0 left') and lets the user submit, which only then fails with a 402 toast. Show an Upgrade CTA instead when left == 0 and the creator isn't already a contact.
paid = ['paid','delivered','completed'], but the backend unmasks for disputed and refunded too (PAID_STATES). The 'hidden until paid' banner still shows on disputed or refunded deals.

issues: The Exit rate and Avg. time columns sit off-screen behind a horizontal scroll (min-w-[520px]), so the key metric isn't visible on mobile. Consider a stacked card layout on mobile.
The legend text is drawn in the bar colours (#3B82F6 / #7C5CFF) on a purple background, which gives low contrast for 'Businesses' and 'Creators'.
Uses the native <input type='date'> picker instead of the shadcn Calendar.
My Profile shows '0 Posts' while the public creator profile shows '1 Posts' for the same creator (the profile photo is counted as a post).

action_items: Fix the double minus in the Journey funnel, and make the funnel sequential (or relabel it as independent reach).
Replace the hard-coded prices and limits in the UI (chat-upgrade-button ₹999/mo, the Dashboard '10% fee', 'Extend 30 days', the Settings 10% fee, the Landing '3 creators') with config values.
Validate that the creator exists in POST /creators/{id}/view; whitelist or rate-limit POST /track.
Dedupe repeated track and view calls (StrictMode double effects).
Hide or label chat threads in /admin/deals.
OfferDialog: show an upgrade CTA when there are no free contacts left for a new creator.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 1569 lines (more than 700). Split it into routers: deals/chat, admin, pricing/analytics, profiles.

contacts_used uses distinct('creator_id') over all deals, including declined and cancelled ones. That matches the 'contacts stay used' rule, but it's a full distinct on every /me call. Index deals.business_id+creator_id.
admin_journey loads up to 100k events into memory per request. Use an aggregation pipeline, or pre-aggregate daily, before traffic grows.
The events collection has no TTL index, so it grows forever. Add a TTL (e.g. 90 days) on 'at' (stored as a string now, so store a datetime for TTL).
The settings pricing doc and PricingIn are good. The Pro payment keeps pro_days at order time, which is correct.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_hiremyface_api.py (updated for the free_contacts rule; the cleanup now also deletes payouts, because a released payout was orphaned before)

success_rate.backend: 100% (7/7 new; 66/66 regression after updating 3 tests for the intended rule change)
success_rate.frontend: ~92% (all requested flows work; the funnel '−-%' display bug and hard-coded price copy are open)

test_credentials: Used the admin, brand and creator +clerk_test users from /app/memory/test_credentials.md via sign-in tickets (/sign-in?__clerk_ticket=...). The admin role was temporarily set to 'owner' for PUT pricing and restored to 'admin'.
seed_data_creation: Everything was cleaned up: deals and chat threads (including the sample_1/2 chats), messages, payouts (plus one orphan payout left by an earlier regression run), payments, notifications, profile_views (sample creators' views counters decremented back to 0), events from my sessions (all sessions first seen after 2026-10-30T16:30, which may also have removed a few events from a main-agent session at that time), the TEST_iter4 fake creators, the settings pricing doc (deleted, so defaults 999/30/10/3 apply), admin_log entries by the test admin, and the test users' creator and business profiles. Roles are member/member/admin with pro_until None. The real users' data (ogi business and its deal, the owner) were not touched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/test_iter4_chat_pricing_growth.py -n 0 (it cleans up before and after; KEEP_ITER4_DATA=1 keeps the data). For UI: python tests/ui_setup_iter4.py (profiles plus tickets); clean with `python tests/ui_setup_iter4.py clean`. Tickets must be opened at /sign-in?__clerk_ticket=<t> (a deep link with the ticket doesn't sign in) and are single-use: run python tests/clerk_helper.py ticket <who> before every browser run. The browser clock is around 2026-10-30, so the offer start_date must be later than that. Seg testids: growth-range-30|90|365, admin-range-today|7d|30d|all. Pricing inputs: pricing-pro_price|pro_days|fee_pct|free_contacts, pricing-save-button (owner only). Sample creators sample_1..8 can be used as extra contacts for the limit test; decrement their views and delete the threads afterwards.
